test_vilbert_torchscript_pretrain: test the ViLBert pretraining model by building it and verifying TorchScript serialization works
test_vilbert_torchscript_finetune: test the ViLBert classification model by building it and verifying TorchScript serialization works
test_vilbert_pretrained_forward_pass: test the ViLBert pretrained model forward pass and compare output with TorchScript scripted model
test_vilbert_finetune_forward_pass: test the ViLBert finetune model forward pass and compare scores with TorchScript scripted model
build_vilbert_model: build a ViLBert model using build_model with a configuration for pretraining or classification head type
